description: The public keys Pulse signs its price prints with, as PEM and JWK, plus the signing algorithm and the exact canonical string format — everything needed to verify a signed print yourself, OFFLINE, with no network call to Pulse. Use it to write your own verifier, or to audit what pulse_verify_print (this pack's ready-made offline checker) is checking against. Needs NO API key. Example: pulse_key_ring({}).
name: pulse_key_ring

activeKid.description: The key id currently signing new prints

algorithm.description: Signing algorithm: ECDSA P-256, SHA-256, IEEE-P1363, base64

canonical.description: Canonical string template with real newlines, fields in signed order

canonicalEscaped.description: Same template with newlines rendered literally, on one line

keyless.description: Always true: this tool needs no API key

note.description: How to rebuild the canonical string and verify by hand

success.description: Pulse's own success flag for this response

usage.description: Points at pulse_verify_print as the ready-made offline checker

verificationKeys.description: All keys in the ring, past and present, each usable by its kid

active.description: Whether this is the key currently signing

kid.description: Key id, matches the kid field on a signed print

title: Pulse Key Ring
